scheme_name: Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for SC Students
other_conditions: Must have availed (or be eligible for) the Centrally Sponsored Post Matric Scholarship during the current academic year.
benefits_summary: Additional maintenance allowance of ₹750 per month for day scholars and ₹1,500 per month for hostel residents, plus a disability allowance of ₹750 per month, each payable for 10 months.
